notes: PleaToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named plea (PLEA) with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. It has no transfer fees, external mint or burn functions, or administrative powers. There are no application contracts. The pool pairs PLEA with IMD at a 1.25% fee and tick spacing 60. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
